summary: Iteration 2 focused on visual/UX fixes (login band, Google logo, Playfair font) and the new glass-votive candle with 3 variants. Backend smoke check: /api/saints and /api/auth/login (admin@misagradocorazon.com/Sagrado2026) both 200. Frontend (mobile 390x844): (1) Login screen — dark hero (candle + brand + tagline) transitions directly into the ivory card, no white/grey band or gap visible; card background rgb(253,251,247). (2) 'Continuar con Google' button now renders the official multicolor Google 'G' SVG with brand palette (#EA4335 red, #4285F4 blue, #FBBC05 yellow, #34A853 green detected in DOM); no envelope icon. (3) Playfair Display font active: 'Iniciar sesión' computed fontFamily = 'PlayfairDisplay-Bold' 28px; accented characters ('ó' in 'Corazón', 'ó' in 'sesión') render correctly with no missing-glyph fallback or crash. Brand title screenshot visually shows Playfair serif with proper accents. (4) Glass votive candles: Altar main candle renders as red glass votive (variant='solemn') with inner light, gold band, and lit flame — no errors. On /light-candle the top preview updates when selecting candle type cards — SVG bounding box changes from basic (~175x175) → solemn (~198x198, larger with gold band) → permanent (~179x179, taller with pedestal + top gold ring), confirming variant swap. Full flow works: pick saint (candle-saint-saint_guadalupe) → type intention 'Por la salud de mi familia' → pick 'permanent' → press Encender vela → success screen 'Tu vela está encendida' appears (verified in DOM). After tapping Continuar the Altar shows the lit candle under 'Mis velas encendidas' as a mini glass votive (mini-sized SVGs visible). Regression flows (register → onboarding with saint_corazon → Altar) also worked end-to-end in this run; deeper regression (Muro/Causas/Misa/Admin) was already validated 100% in iteration_1 and backend endpoints are unchanged. One console error observed: '<rect> attribute height: A negative value is not valid. ("-10.520000000000003")' — coming from GlassVotive's right specular-highlight rect at small candle sizes (mini candle size≈54). Non-blocking (candles still render) but should be clamped to avoid noisy console errors on the Altar mini list.

ui_bugs.component: GlassVotive (mini candle in Altar 'Mis velas encendidas')
ui_bugs.issue: SVG console error: '<rect> attribute height: A negative value is not valid. ("-10.520...")'. Right specular-highlight Rect at CandleFlame.tsx:239 uses height = glassBottom - rimY - 34, which is negative for small candle sizes (size≈54 → bodyH≈33 → height≈-10.5). Clamp with Math.max(0, …) or skip that Rect when bodyH is below a threshold. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/CandleFlame.tsx:239

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/components/CandleFlame.tsx GlassVotive, clamp specular-highlight rect heights to >=0 (Math.max) or skip highlights when bodyH is too small, to eliminate the '<rect> height negative' console error on mini candles. Repro: light any candle then look at Altar 'Mis velas encendidas' or shrink CandleFlame size below ~60.
critical_code_review_comments: GlassVotive (CandleFlame.tsx) hard-codes several rect y/height offsets (e.g. rimY+10, height = glassBottom - rimY - 34) that break at small sizes; parameterize by size or clamp.

Light-candle preview container styles.preview has height 250; CandleFlame(size=150) computes wrapH ≈ 262.5, so ~12px of the top of the wrap overlaps the section label above. Consider raising preview height to 270 or lowering candle size to ~140 for a cleaner layout.
AltarStage flameArea height 300 works, but the LinearGradient bgOverlay is only 400px tall — on taller devices the transition may look abrupt. Non-blocking.

rca_of_issue: GlassVotive negative-rect: CandleFlame.tsx:239 defines the right highlight Rect with height = glassBottom - rimY - 34. For any candle where bodyH < ~44 (typical for the mini candle at size=54 → bodyH=33.48), this expression is negative and react-native-svg logs the error. Mitigation: replace with `Math.max(0, glassBottom - rimY - 34)` or gate the highlight rects on a minimum size (e.g. only render when size >= 80).
